geoguide.description: This project aimed to design software with a graphical interface to calculate driving times between two cities in France. The requirements were to use CSV files containing travel times between specific pairs of cities to find the shortest route. This project was completed as part of an assignment during my first year of the BUT Computer Science program.
geoguide.role: Main designer and developer. I designed the user interface, developed the travel time calculation and mapping features, and integrated the city data.
geoguide.toolsDescription: I implemented the Floyd-Warshall algorithm to fill in the missing information regarding travel times between remaining pairs of cities. I used GitLab for version control, Visual Studio Code for editing the code, and Qt Creator for UI design.
geoguide.visualDescription: Below you can see screenshots of my application. The map is interactive: you can zoom in, zoom out, and move around.
geoguide.challenges: The hardest part of this assignment was setting up the interactive map with QML and the visual aspect of the application. I really wanted my software to be aesthetically pleasing.
geoguide.solutions: The solutions that helped me overcome these difficulties were researching QML by watching videos and studying code from other developers on GitHub to understand how it works.
geoguide.impactDescription: Completing this project allowed me to expand my knowledge of Qt and QML, and to deepen my mastery of C++. After the presentation, I received a grade of 18/20.

planifEasy.description: Planif'Easy is a console-based application for managing personalized schedules. It also offers the ability to export schedules as HTML pages for easy viewing in a browser.
planifEasy.role: Lead developer and designer. I designed and developed the app from scratch, handling the requirements analysis, programming, and creating the export features.
planifEasy.toolsDescription: I used Visual Studio Code for coding and debugging, and Git for version control and change tracking.
planifEasy.visualDescription: Below, you'll find screenshots of the application showing the different steps: schedule creation, event management, and HTML export.
planifEasy.challenges: The main challenge was to design an intuitive user interface despite the console format, as well as the dynamic generation of cross-browser compatible HTML files.
planifEasy.solutions: For the user interface, I opted for simple navigation based on clear text menus. For HTML compatibility, I used predefined templates combined with C++ code generation.
planifEasy.impactDescription: Planif'Easy simplifies schedule management for non-technical users, offering a lightweight and portable solution. Exporting to HTML allows for great accessibility and easy sharing.

station.description: This project involved creating a web application capable of locating the nearest gas stations to a given position. The application displays stations on an interactive map and provides detailed information about each one.
station.role: Lead designer and developer. I designed the user interface, developed the geolocation and mapping features, and integrated the gas station data.
station.toolsDescription: I used Visual Studio Code for the code, Leaflet.js for mapping, Webpack for module management, and Git for version control.
station.visualDescription: The screenshots below show the application interface with the interactive map displaying the stations and their information.
station.challenges: The main challenge was integrating gas station data via an external API and clearly displaying them on the map.
station.solutions: I used the OpenDataSoft API to retrieve the data, and created customized markers to display them on the map.
station.impactDescription: This application offers a simple and efficient solution to quickly find the closest gas stations.

studentManagement.description: The Student Manager project aimed to create a student management app for a university. It is used to add, edit, delete students, manage absences, and check their details.
studentManagement.role: Team project: user interface design, development of student management features, and data integration.
studentManagement.toolsDescription: GitLab for version tracking, VS Code for code editing, and Qt Creator for UI design.
studentManagement.visualDescription: The screenshots below display the core features for student and absence management.
studentManagement.challenges: The major difficulty was effectively managing the data and CSV/JSON import/export.
studentManagement.solutions: We used proper data structures and robust manipulation functions to add, edit, and delete data.
studentManagement.impactDescription: The application delivers a complete solution for the administrative management of students and their absences, streamlining the work of universities.

websiteSAE.description: This SAE project involved creating a website showcasing the Aix-Marseille IUT, Arles campus.
websiteSAE.role: Project made in a group of 3: UI design, development of presentation features, and integration of educational programs data.
websiteSAE.toolsDescription: Visual Studio Code was used for coding and Git for tracking changes.
websiteSAE.visualDescription: The screenshots depict the pages of the website presenting the IUT and its available courses.
websiteSAE.challenges: The main challenge was to design a beautiful website while keeping a clear and hierarchical presentation.
websiteSAE.solutions: We used modern design patterns and organized the information to ensure smooth navigation.
websiteSAE.impactDescription: The website offers a thorough and clear presentation of the Aix-Marseille IUT, making it easy to discover the institution.

horaris.description: Horaris is a meeting room management application for a company. It allows users to book rooms, check availability, and manage reservations. This project is currently in development and may be used as part of Arles Creative.
horaris.role: Scrum Master and front-end developer in an Agile team. I am responsible for the UI integration and technical coordination.
horaris.toolsDescription: Visual Studio Code for development and Git for version management.
horaris.visualDescription: The screenshots below feature the main pages of the app, highlighting the booking and availability management functionalities.
horaris.challenges: The main issue is designing an ergonomic and intuitive application while providing advanced functionalities.
horaris.solutions: We stick to modern design patterns and clear information hierarchy for a seamless navigation experience.
horaris.impactDescription: Horaris will offer a comprehensive solution for managing meeting rooms, simplifying meeting planning and coordination.

memoryGame.description: Memory Game is a classic matching game where the player has to turn over cards to find corresponding pairs. This project was built during a web development course.
memoryGame.role: Lead developer and designer. I designed the user interface, coded the game mechanisms, and embedded the cards.
memoryGame.toolsDescription: I used Visual Studio Code for coding and Git for version control.
memoryGame.visualDescription: The screenshots below show the game interface, with cards to flip and pairs to uncover.
memoryGame.challenges: The main challenge in this project was creating a smooth and interactive game while keeping a delightful user experience.
memoryGame.solutions: I used CSS animations for transitions and set up a reactive game logic using React to handle pairs and scores.
memoryGame.impactDescription: Memory Game offers an entertaining and stimulating gameplay experience, testing players' memory and focus.

kubo.description: Kubo is a 3D model management application, a simplified web version of the 3D editing tool Blender. This work was done as part of my 3rd year BUT Computer Science SAE assignment.
kubo.role: During this project, I was the main designer and developer. I designed the UI, built the 3D model management features, and integrated the manipulating tools.
kubo.toolsDescription: Visual Studio Code for development and Git for version control.
kubo.visualDescription: The screenshots below display the app's main pages, such as the homepage, login page, registration page, and the main 3D model management dashboard.
kubo.challenges: The primary obstacle was designing a robust and scalable application while delivering a smooth UX. I challenged myself by implementing a hexagonal architecture for better scalability and maintainability.
kubo.solutions: We rely on a modular architecture and modern best practices to ensure code quality and application maintenance.
kubo.impactDescription: Kubo will provide an easy-to-use solution to quickly access 3D model visualization and management, with a straightforward interface and features tailored to users' needs.

resonance.description: During an event called DevArt, which consists of creating digital art within 36 hours, my team and I built Resonance, an artwork based on the theme of echo. It's a fun mini-game created on Unity where the goal is to pass through a series of obstacles by making them resonate. To do this, we use a piano to hit the correct key that makes the obstacle resonate, causing it to disappear. This project was built by a team of 4 people.
resonance.role: I was a developer and game designer; I assisted in designing the sceneries and gameplay elements, and I programmed the character's resonance and movement mechanics.
resonance.toolsDescription: We used Visual Studio Code for coding and Git for version management.
resonance.visualDescription: The screenshots below showcase the application interface, the scenery, and the gameplay items.
resonance.challenges: The biggest challenge was the tight 36-hour deadline to build a full, playable piece of art, alongside the need for effective team coordination to split tasks and maintain solid communication.
resonance.solutions: To maintain proper communication, we set up short, recurring check-ins to monitor everyone's progress and adjust tasks accordingly.
resonance.impactDescription: To dive a bit deeper into the lore of the piece, the objective of the game is to teach music—at least piano notes—in a fun and interactive way. For this, we embody a little character searching for their soulmate, and to find them, they must enter into resonance while overcoming a series of roadblocks. This project was incredibly enriching, allowed me to improve my video game development skills, and taught me how to work as a team under fast-paced constraints.
